description: A confirmation alert over the main window before a session's transcript is moved to the trash.
opens: session row right-click → Move to Trash…

parts.name: heading
parts.shows: Move “<title>” to the trash? (the title, or "this session" if it has none).

parts.name: body
parts.shows: "Its transcript will be moved to <where>, where you can restore it." where is "your trash" for this machine's sessions, or "the trash on <host>" for a session on a host. When earlier copies of the conversation were folded into this session: "Its transcript and its N earlier copy/copies will be moved to <where>, where you can restore it." For a session on Codex's model, a line is added: "Codex keeps its own copy of this session."

parts.name: Cancel
parts.shows: "Cancel" button; the default response and Escape.

parts.name: Move to Trash
parts.shows: "Move to Trash" button in the destructive (red) style.

actions.does: This machine's: the transcript and its copies go to the system trash (if the filesystem has none, they are moved to Baude's own trash folder and a note says where). If it's the open chat, a new session opens; the list refreshes. On a host: the host's process moves it to its trash; the session leaves the list, and the open chat if it was this one is left for a new one. A host that refuses says "<host> didn't delete it: <why>" in a toast.
